title: Chapter 351 Deduction Of The Method
content:
Chapter 351 Deduction Of The Method

Immediately checked them one by one.

He first clicked on the "gun" stone.

The stones on the stone wall were arranged in a whole group, and finally a bookshelf appeared.

There were hundreds of external skills about guns on it.

"Destroying Gun Skills", "Frost Gun Skills", "Red Phoenix Skyward Gun", "Huntian Gun"...

Wang Shuo was dazzled by it.

Each kind of skill, when cultivated to the extreme, is considered to be infinitely powerful.

Although it cannot split mountains and seas, it is not a problem to split gold and break stones.

But there is a disadvantage, these gun skills are only yellow-level skills.

And they also need corresponding internal skills to exert the greatest power.

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to choose the lowest-level skill here, which even has no level - "Basic Gun Skills", to make up for his weakness of not having a gun skill foundation.

At this time, Wang Shuo noticed that there was another box on this bookshelf.

It said deduction of skills.

Wang Shuo was shocked that there was such a magical object.

His eyes lit up.

He wanted to try it out.

He put a copy of "Hun Tian Gun" into it and found no change.

At this time, he seemed to feel that he had to put in his existing skills to have an effect.

He immediately thought of his "You Long Gun Jue" and wondered if there was any way to deduce it.

Thinking of this, he tried hard to recall the entire skill in his mind.

Unexpectedly, it really condensed into a secret book and appeared in his hand.

Wang Shuo was a little surprised by this magical phenomenon, but this War General Tower was a miracle, so what was this!

He put it in the box.

He closed the lid and didn't know what to do, so he just prayed.

At this moment, a sudden change occurred, and the whole wooden box flashed with light.

After the change was over, Wang Shuo opened it again.

"You Long Gun Jue" really changed and turned into a mysterious skill.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed.

[Dragon Spear Art: A Xuan-level technique, with nine levels in total. When you practice to the first level, you can comprehend the Dragon-Transforming Strike, the third level comprehends the Dragon Out of the Sea, the fifth level comprehends the Flying Dragon in the Sky, the seventh level hits the Yellow Dragon, and the ninth level is the Great Power Heavenly Dragon. Currently, you can practice to the fifth level. ]

Just then, Wang Shuo noticed that his Dragon-Transforming Strike skill disappeared.

Also, although "Dragon Spear Art" has become a Xuan-level technique, it seems to have become a fragment.

Oh my god!

Is this a profit or a loss?

If you can practice to the fifth level, it is considered a Xuan-level technique. If you practice to the seventh level, will it become a ground-level technique, and then the ninth level, a heaven-level technique.

Wang Shuo guessed in his heart.

Now that things have come to this, it seems that I have to find another opportunity to upgrade the level of this technique in the future.

Afterwards, Wang Shuo wanted to click to learn. Although the book disappeared, Wang Shuo did not learn it, but only knew how to practice.

Do I have to practice step by step?

Wang Shuo thought that this war general tower was full of weirdness, and he could only try to practice according to the cultivation method in the technique.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo thought of his "Black Dragon Sutra", wondering if he could still upgrade the level.

In the same way, Wang Shuo put the "Black Dragon Sutra" in, but there was no reaction.

Wang Shuo couldn't help showing disappointment.

The "Black Dragon Sutra" was originally a ground-level technique.

And this small wooden box should only be able to be deduced to the Xuan level.

Otherwise, this small box might be a treasure of the heaven-defying level.

And looking at the current situation, I'm afraid everyone can use it for free.

Then, Wang Shuo began to practice according to the above method.
